mapper.select: SELECT m.*, COUNT(p.participant_id) AS current_people FROM personal_match m LEFT JOIN personal_match_participant p ON m.personal_match_id = p.personal_match_id GROUP BY m.personal_match_id ORDER BY m.created_at DESC LIMIT 4;

SELECT m.*, COUNT(p.participant_id) AS current_people FROM personal_match m LEFT JOIN personal_match_participant p ON m.personal_match_id = p.personal_match_id GROUP BY m.personal_match_id ORDER BY m.created_at DESC LIMIT 4;

SELECT m.*, COUNT(p.participant_id) AS current_people FROM personal_match m LEFT JOIN personal_match_participant p ON m.personal_match_id = p.personal_match_id GROUP BY m.personal_match_id ORDER BY m.created_at DESC LIMIT #{startIndex},4;

select count(distinct m.personal_match_id) from personal_match m left join personal_match_participant p on p.personal_match_id = m.personal_match_id and p.user_id = #{userId} and p.status in ('PAID', 'HOST') where (m.user_id = #{userId} or p.user_id is not null)
and m.match_date >= STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{month}, '-01'), '%Y-%m-%d') and m.match_date < DATE_ADD(STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{month}, '-01'), '%Y-%m-%d'), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)

SELECT m.*, u.nickname, COUNT(p.participant_id) AS current_people FROM personal_match m LEFT JOIN personal_match_participant p ON m.personal_match_id = p.personal_match_id LEFT JOIN user u ON m.user_id = u.user_id WHERE m.personal_match_id = #{personaMatchId} GROUP BY m.personal_match_id ORDER BY m.created_at DESC;
